localContext: Berwyn, IL is known for its Chicago-style brick bungalows. Many of these homes, built in the 1920s, have original detached alley garages. These garages often use first or second-generation hardware. This older equipment was designed for narrower Model T-width cars. Modern SUVs demand smooth, full-width travel. Worn rollers and bent track in a 100-year-old garage often cannot deliver this. This mismatch strains old parts. Chicago-area weather compounds these problems. Extreme temperature swings cause metal components to expand and contract. Humidity and road salt accelerate corrosion. Springs weaken. Cables fray. Rollers seize. These factors often lead to sudden failures, like a spring snapping at night or a door coming off its tracks in the Proksa Park area. Our team understands these specific challenges in Berwyn. We know how the local housing stock and weather affect garage door longevity.
